description: This source file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` that facilitate batch processing of large item sets in a way that yields control back to the main thread, improving UI responsiveness. It is used for progressive operations like expanding tree nodes in a user interface, managing progress and cancellation.

methods.description: Creates a controller that processes items in batches asynchronously, respecting time constraints for UI responsiveness, with support for progress updates, cancellation, and completion callbacks.

methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to provide UI state (running, progress, counts) and control functions (start, cancel) for progressive batch processing in React components.
